provenance.method: web-verified by a research pass on 19 Sep 2026; official house and parent-company press pages first (Estée Lauder Companies, Kering, LVMH), then dated trade press and reference publishers

provenance.unknownDates: an unknown date stays null with datePrecision unknown; nothing here is guessed
provenance.correction: corrections belong in this file with an updated source, never in a silent edit
